about.dashboard: Greeting and a way into every area you can use.
about.modules: Modules installed on this server: permissions, events, jobs, migrations.
about.access: Accounts, roles and permissions; invitations, delegation, store profiles and support access.
about.entries: Posts and pages: drafts, review, scheduling, translations, SEO.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in with an account of the Autoxide server.
login.mfaDescription: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
login.mfaExpired: The sign-in step expired. Sign in again.
login.unreachable: The Autoxide server does not answer. Try again in a moment.
login.deleted: Your account was deleted and you were signed out.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Modules installed in this server, in start order. Modules are compiled into the server: installing or removing one means rebuilding it.
modules.name: Name
modules.pendingHint: Run `autoxide migrate up` on the server to apply pending migrations.

errors.forbidden: Your account lacks the permission `{permission}`. Ask an administrator to give it to one of your roles.
errors.failed: The page could not be loaded. Try again; if it keeps failing, check that the Autoxide server is running.

form.fix: {count, plural, one {One field needs fixing.} other {# fields need fixing.}}

shell.home: Autoxide admin, go to the overview
shell.searchPlaceholder: Find a page or an area…
shell.noMatch: No page matches. Try the name of an area, such as "modules".

dashboard.description: Every area you can use on this server. Areas appear here once their module is installed and your role grants their permission.
dashboard.nothing: No area is available to you yet. Ask an administrator to add a role with the permissions you need.

account.title: My account
account.description: Your profile, how you sign in, the devices signed in to your account, and your data. You do all of this yourself; nobody has to approve it.

required.name: Give the passkey a name, up to 100 characters.
required.confirm_email: Type your email address to confirm.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHint: To change your display name, ask an administrator.
profile.unverifiedHint: Open the link in the verification mail to confirm this address.

email.sent: A verification mail is on its way to {email}.
email.changeIntro: The verification mail goes to the NEW address. Your email changes only when you open its link within 24 hours; until then the current address stays in use.

password.title: Password
password.meta: Changing it signs out every other device.
password.intro: Every other device is signed out; you stay signed in here. Several wrong current passwords lock sign-in for this email for a while.
password.done: Password changed. Other devices must sign in again.

totp.title: Two-step sign-in (authenticator app)
totp.onMeta: Sign-in asks for a code from your app. {remaining, plural, one {# recovery code left} other {# recovery codes left}}.
totp.offMeta: Add a 6-digit code from an app such as an authenticator to every sign-in.
totp.lowCodes: {remaining, plural, =0 {No recovery code left.} one {Only # recovery code left.} other {Only # recovery codes left.}} Make new ones before you lose your phone.
totp.enableIntro: You will scan a code with your authenticator app, then type the code the app shows.
totp.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key by hand. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qrLabel: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
totp.newCodesIntro: Ten new codes replace the old ones; the old ones stop working.
totp.codesReplaced: New recovery codes made; the old ones no longer work.
totp.disableIntro: Your remaining recovery codes are deleted. Signing in then needs only your password or a passkey.

codes.once: These codes are shown only this once. Each works once in place of a code from the app, for example after losing your phone. Store them somewhere safe, away from the phone.
codes.label: Recovery codes
codes.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying. Download the codes or write them down.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.about: A passkey signs you in with the fingerprint, face or PIN of a device, and cannot be phished like a password.
passkeys.addIntro: Your browser then asks for the fingerprint, face or PIN of this device, or of a security key.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.nameHint: To recognize it later, for example "Work laptop".
passkeys.unsupported: This browser cannot create passkeys. Use a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
passkeys.cancelled: The passkey was not created: the request was cancelled or timed out.
passkeys.exists: This device already holds a passkey for your account.
passkeys.failed: The browser could not create the passkey. Try again.
passkeys.removeIntro: It stops working at once. Delete it from the device as well.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.about: See a device you do not know? Sign it out, then change your password.
sessions.ended: Signed out. That device must sign in again.
sessions.endOthersIntro: {count, plural, one {The other device} other {All # other devices}} must sign in again. You stay signed in here. A device signed out can keep working until its current access expires (15 minutes by default).
sessions.endedOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other device was signed in.} one {Signed out # device.} other {Signed out # devices.}}
sessions.useSignOut: This is the session you are using. Sign out from the account menu instead.
sessions.unknownCurrent: This session is not recognized yet, so it cannot be marked or kept. Sign out and in again, or wait a few minutes.

data.title: My data
data.exportMeta: A JSON file with everything the server keeps about you: profile, roles, sessions, API keys, passkeys, two-step sign-in status, and what each module keeps. Passwords, tokens and keys are never in it.
data.deleteMeta: Deletes your account at once. This cannot be undone.
data.lastAdmin: If you are the last administrator, give the admin role to someone else before deleting your account.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.goesNow: removes your account, sessions, API keys and passkeys at once, and signs you out;
delete.goesLater: removes the data other modules keep for you (notes, files…) shortly after;
delete.mismatch: This is not your email. Type {email} exactly.

sample.badge: Sample data · waiting for API step {step}
sample.missing: Not in the core yet: {endpoint}. Changes here are kept in memory only and are lost when the app restarts.

codes.auth_invitation_invalid: This invitation was already used, revoked or has expired.
codes.auth_delegation_not_active: This delegation is no longer active.
codes.auth_support_grant_not_active: This grant is no longer in effect.

fields.unknown: Choose one of the listed values.
fields.past: Choose a date in the future.

access.crumb: Organization · accounts, roles, invitations, delegation, support access
access.title: Users and roles
access.description: Who can sign in and what each person may do. A role is a set of permissions; a person with several roles has every permission of all of them.

required.name: Enter a display name.
required.confirm_email: Type the email address to confirm.
required.display_name: Enter the name shown on the website.

create.title: New user
create.intro: The account starts without a role: give it roles on the next page. A mail asking to confirm the address goes to the new email.
create.name: Display name
create.passwordHint: 12 to 128 characters. Leave empty to let the person set it through a password-reset mail, or set a first password later.
create.done: User created. Give them roles below.

user.notFound: No user has this id. The account may have been deleted.
user.name: Display name

status.title: Status
status.activeHint: Can sign in and use the API.
status.disableNow: They are signed out everywhere and their access tokens stop working at once.
status.disableKeep: The account, its roles and its data stay; they cannot sign in until enabled again.
status.disableUndo: You can enable the account again at any time.
status.disabled: Account disabled; they were signed out everywhere.

roles.title: Roles
roles.about: Saving replaces every role of this person. Changes apply on their next request.
roles.everything: Every permission, including ones added later.

delete.title: Delete {who}?
delete.goesNow: The account and its sign-in methods are deleted now.
delete.goesLater: Data other modules keep for this person is deleted shortly after.
delete.noUndo: This cannot be undone. To only stop them from signing in, disable the account instead.
delete.meta: Removes the account and everything it owns. Needs every permission the person has.

admin.title: Administrator actions
admin.about: Actions on someone else's account. Check who is asking before using them.

reset.title: Send a password-reset mail
reset.meta: The person chooses a new password from the link (valid 30 minutes). Administrators cannot replace an existing password.
reset.sent: If the account is active, a reset mail is on its way to {email}.

password.meta: Only for an account created without a password.
password.title: First password for {who}
password.intro: Works only when the account has no password yet. To change an existing password, send a password-reset mail.
password.done: Password set; they can sign in with it.

sessions.meta: Ends every session of this person on every device.
sessions.title: Sign {who} out everywhere?
sessions.now: Every session ends; each device must sign in again.
sessions.tokens: An access token already issued keeps working until it expires (15 minutes by default).
sessions.keepOut: To keep them out for good, disable the account instead.
sessions.done: {count, plural, =0 {They had no session.} one {Ended # session.} other {Ended # sessions.}}

mfa.meta: For a person who lost the device with their authenticator app.
mfa.title: Turn off two-step sign-in for {who}?
mfa.effect: They sign in with the password alone, then can set up a new device.
mfa.check: Make sure the request really comes from them: anyone who knows the password can then sign in.
mfa.done: Two-step sign-in is off for this account.

roles.title: Roles
roles.about: Open a role to see and change its permissions. The built-in admin role grants every permission and cannot be changed.
roles.count: {count, plural, =0 {No permission} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}

role.notFound: No role has this id. It may have been deleted.
role.builtinNote: Built-in role: it grants every permission, including permissions added later by new modules. It cannot be changed or deleted, and at least one active user must keep it.
role.name: Name
role.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, _ and -, starting with a letter. Example: editor.
role.findHint: Find by name or what it allows…
role.unknown: No longer offered by any module.
role.readOnly: You can see this role but not change it (needs auth.roles.manage).

delete.title: Delete the role {name}?
delete.holders: Everyone who has this role loses its permissions on their next request.

invitations.inviteIntro: The person gets a one-time link, valid 7 days. Without an account they set a password or add a passkey when accepting.
invitations.sent: Invitation sent; follow it in this list.
invitations.name: Name (optional)
invitations.depth: How far each permission reaches is set by the role, not here. You can only invite with roles whose permissions you hold at that unit.
invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.about: Pending, accepted, expired or revoked invitations. Needs auth.invitations.manage at the unit invited to.
invitations.resent: Sent again to {email}; the old link stopped working.
invitations.revokeLink: The link in the mail stops working at once.
invitations.revokeAgain: To invite them later, send a new invitation.

delegations.createIntro: Whoever holds this role at your root can work in the child customer with exactly those permissions. The child sees the delegation but cannot revoke it.
delegations.created: Delegated; the event is recorded at both customers.
delegations.expiresHint: Empty: no end date. Ends at the end of that day (UTC).
delegations.reasonHint: 10 to 500 characters; both customers see it in their audit log.
delegations.title: Outgoing delegation
delegations.audit: Each time your staff enter a child customer through a delegation, the event is recorded there and copied back to you, so both sides can look it up.
delegations.revokeNow: Sessions opened through it lose their permissions on the next request.
delegations.revokeAudit: The revocation is recorded at both customers.

public.about: What the website shows about each store: name, address, opening hours, pickup. Only units marked public appear; members and internal settings never do.
public.readOnly: You can see these profiles but not change them (needs {permission}).
public.saved: Saved; the store page on the website updates in a few minutes.
public.isPublicHint: Off: the unit disappears from the list of stores.
public.provinceHint: Address follows the administrative units after the 2025 merger: province or city, then ward or commune (no district).
public.hoursHint: Same hours every day. Hours per day and special closing days need the API.
public.pickupHint: Buyers can choose this store at checkout.

support.isOn: Platform staff may enter to help when you report a problem.
support.isOff: Only requests from a competent authority (with a document number) can be granted.
support.revokeNote: Step 34 of the core only lets the platform operator revoke a grant. The Revoke button below follows the proposed API: you control the data, so you should be able to end access yourself.
support.revokeNow: Their support session loses its permissions on the next request.
support.revokeAudit: The revocation is recorded in your audit log.
support.saved: Saved; new grants follow this setting.
support.allow: Platform staff may enter when you report a problem
support.allowHint: Off: only requests from a competent authority (with a document number) can be granted, and those are still recorded here.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the mail again, or ask for a new mail.
verify.done: {email} is confirmed. If you asked to change your address, sign in with this one from now on.
verify.description: Confirm that this address belongs to you.
verify.invalidHint: Sign in and send a new verification mail from My account.

forgot.done: If an account has the address {email}, a mail with a link to choose a new password is on its way. The link works for 30 minutes.
forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.description: Enter the email of your account; we send a link to choose a new password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.noToken: This link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
reset.done: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.
reset.description: The link from the mail works once, for 30 minutes.

list.title: Posts
list.description: Every post and page of the website, drafts included. Open one to write, review, schedule or publish it.
list.noMatch: No post or page matches these filters.
list.empty: No posts or pages yet. Create the first one with "New post".

editor.linkInvalid: Use an address that starts with https://, http://, mailto: or / (a page of this site).
editor.linkHint: Links to javascript: and other unsafe addresses are refused by the server.
editor.embedHint: Only sites the server allows can be embedded (by default YouTube and Vimeo).
editor.conflict: Someone changed this entry after you opened it. Nothing was overwritten. Reload to see their version; your unsaved changes here will be lost, so copy any text you want to keep first.
editor.words: {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} · {minutes, plural, one {# min read} other {# min read}}
editor.title: Title
editor.excerptHint: Shown in lists, feeds and link previews.
editor.bodyHint: Saved as structured blocks, not HTML. The server checks every block and reports problems with their place.
editor.readOnly: You can read this entry but not change it: your role lacks content.write.

panel.label: Entry settings
panel.unpublished: Taken down: readers no longer see it
panel.viaApiKey: with an API key (machine or AI agent)
panel.schedulePinned: A scheduled publish keeps the draft as it was when scheduled; later edits are not published by it.
panel.slugHint: Changing it after publishing makes the old address redirect (301) to the new one. Leave it empty to make one from the title.
panel.aiNote: AI only suggests or writes drafts; it never publishes. Readers are told when content was made with AI.
panel.unpublishIntro: Readers stop seeing it at once and its address answers 404. It becomes a draft again and can be published later. A pending scheduled publish is canceled.
panel.archiveIntro: It is taken down for good: its address answers 410 (gone) so search engines drop it, and every pending schedule is canceled. It can still be published again later.
panel.archiveDraftIntro: The draft is put away: it leaves the drafts list and every pending schedule is canceled. It can still be published later.
panel.noAuthors: No author profiles yet. Someone with content.manage creates them.
panel.authorsHint: In the order you tick them; the first is the main author. Takes effect at once, also on the published version.
panel.noTerms: No categories or tags yet. Someone with content.manage creates them.
panel.termsHint: The first category ticked is the main one. Takes effect at once, also on the published version.

seo.checkUnavailable: The check could not be run.
seo.checkSaved: The check reads the saved draft: save to check your latest changes.
seo.canonicalHint: Only when the content first appeared on another site; leave empty otherwise.
seo.noindex: Ask search engines not to index it
seo.noindexHint: noindex: the page stays reachable but is left out of search results.
seo.suggestHint: Uses AI tokens. Nothing is changed until you apply it; applying marks the entry as AI-assisted.
seo.aiForbidden: Unavailable: your role cannot see whether AI is on (ai.view).
seo.aiOff: AI is off on this server. The operator turns it on with the AUTOXIDE_AI_* settings.

codes.excerptMissing: No summary: lists, feeds and link previews have nothing to show.
codes.headingSkipped: A heading level is skipped (for example heading 2 then heading 4).
codes.imageAltMissing: An image has no text alternative.
codes.metaDescriptionMissing: No search description: search engines pick a sentence themselves.
codes.metaDescriptionTooLong: The search description is too long; search engines cut it.
codes.metaTitleMissing: No search title: the title is used.
codes.metaTitleTooLong: The search title is too long; search engines cut it.
codes.noindexPublished: It is published but asks search engines not to index it.
codes.shareImageMissing: No image for social sharing (and no main image to fall back on).
codes.titleDuplicate: Another entry in this language has the same title.

languages.outdated: Translation is out of date: the original changed
languages.aiOff: Translating with AI needs AI turned on on this server.
languages.queued: Translation started; it appears as a draft when done
languages.note: Each translation is its own entry: own address, status, schedule and history. A missing translation is never replaced by another language.

history.restoreIntro: Its title, text, summary and SEO fields are copied into the draft. Nothing is published; categories, tags and authors stay as they are.
history.note: The server keeps a revision on creation, on each publish and take-down, on restore, and when the last one is more than 10 minutes old.

publish.intro: Readers will see the draft as it is now, at {path}.
publish.introPage: Readers will see the draft as it is now, under its parent page.
publish.savesFirst: Your unsaved changes are saved first.
publish.nothingNew: The published version already matches the draft.
publish.seoErrors: The SEO check found problems to fix. You can still publish.
publish.reviewRequired: Confirm that you read and reviewed the parts written by AI.
publish.whenInvalid: Pick a date and time in the future.
publish.laterHint: The draft as it is now is published at that time, even if you edit it later.
publish.aiReviewed: I read and reviewed the parts made with AI
publish.aiReviewedHint: The published version records who reviewed it and when; the website can show readers that AI helped.
publish.permission: Needs content.publish. Each publish keeps a revision and is recorded in the audit log.
publish.scheduleUnpublishIntro: The entry is taken down at that time (its address answers 404).

preview.title: Preview the draft
preview.intro: Anyone with the link can read the saved draft, without an account, until the link expires (10 minutes by default).
preview.savesFirst: Your unsaved changes are saved first.
preview.banner: Draft preview — readers do not see this version.
preview.aiNotice: Made with the help of AI.
preview.invalid: This preview link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.

new.description: Write a first draft. Nothing is published until you publish it.
new.localeHint: Other languages are added later as translations.
new.slugHint: Optional: made from the title when empty.
new.draftNote: SEO, authors, categories, preview and publishing are in the editor once the draft is created.

sample.sitesNote: Each domain is a website owned by an organization unit. Posts are not tied to a website yet: the list shows every post.
sample.requiredSales: An online shop must publish these pages before notifying the Ministry of Industry and Trade (Decree 52/2013, amended by Decree 85/2021; check the original text).
sample.requiredPlatform: A marketplace also needs its operating rules, a contract template for sellers and seller information on product pages before registering.
sample.drafted: Draft created from the template; fill in your details, then publish
sample.owner: Owned by {owner}: people there and in parent units can edit it.
